title: MoCRA: Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act — FDA Compliance Intelligence
excerpt: MoCRA is the first major overhaul of U.S. cosmetics regulation since 1938. Facility registration, product listing, and adverse event reporting are now mandatory. GMP and fragrance allergen rules remain delayed into 2026+.
seo_title: MoCRA FDA Compliance: Deadlines, Requirements & Enforcement | Policy Canary
seo_description: MoCRA compliance guide: facility registration, product listing, adverse event reporting, GMP timeline, PFAS report, and FDA enforcement actions.
